title: Synthetic audit storage before indexing and replication
method: Synthetic constant 200 records/second ×600 bytes/record ×86,400 seconds/day ÷1,000,000,000 =10.368 decimal GB/day. Excludes indexing, replication, compression, metadata, and bursts. Records are not necessarily events.
alt: Raw audit storage grows from 10.368 GB for 1 day to 72.576 GB for 7 days and 311.04 GB for 30 days under a fixed synthetic record rate.
